==Rules==
{{Season|Summer|8}}
{{Urizen Lore}}
===Performing the Ritual===
{{Casting time|2}} {{Target Character}} The target character must possess the [[Magical skills#Battle Mage|battle mage]] skill.

{{enchantment}}

===Effects===
The target gains the ability to expand a point of personal mana to call [[Calls#CLEAVE|CLEAVE]] when wielding a staff [[Weapons_%26_armour#Implements|implement]]. The target must follow all the rules for casting an [[Spellcasting#Offensive_Spells|offensive spell]], and must recite an appropriate incantation before using their staff this way.

While under the effect of the enchantment the target experiences a roleplaying effect: ''you find it difficult to control you temper, and any irritation or anger you experience is significantly stronger to the point it may overpower your good sense if only for a few moments.'' 

This effect is even more pronounced if you have the [[changeling]] [[lineage]].

{{Season Duration}}

===Additional Targets===
This ritual can affect additional characters from the same [[coven]]. Each additional character increases the magnitude by 6. Additional characters must be present throughout.
